evidence.quote:
def split_pdf(input_file, output_dir="."):
    reader = PdfReader(input_file)
    
    for i, page in enumerate(reader.pages):
        writer = PdfWriter()
        writer.add_page(page)
        with open(f"{output_dir}/page_{i+1}.pdf", "wb") as f:
            writer.write(f)
